components.grid rows below the breakpoint: GAP:ruled:d8ef0463 — no explicit grid-template-rows from JS below the tablet/phone breakpoint; grid-auto-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) with no explicit row template lets CSS Grid derive the row count from the actual number of cards (each alone in its column at 1-col width) and distribute available height equally, shrinkable — zero JS resize listener needed

states.desktop/tablet, N columns: unchanged — explicit --deck-cols/--deck-rows from layout.yaml's declared column count, as today
states.phone, 1 column, fewer cards than fit na: each card gets more than an equal 1/N share is needed for — no visible change from today's single-card case
states.phone, 1 column, more cards than fit nat: each card is squeezed to its 1/N share of the fixed viewport height; per-card internal scrolling (where the card provides it) is the only escape hatch — no page-level scroll, per [node:1580e5d3]

behavior: Column count still comes from the existing hardcoded 767px media query (unchanged this pass — server-driven breakpoints from the theme's own breakpointTabletPx/breakpointDesktopPx are a separate, blocked-on-v1/v2-schema-adoption follow-up, [node:611bc3d8]).
Row count is never JS-computed below the breakpoint — it falls out of the number of grid children automatically, so it cannot drift out of sync with the column count again.

regions.label: status group (shell-status: changelog button, status text, cursor) — drops to its own row when tight

components.header row: GAP:ruled:538d1960 — flex-wrap: wrap added to .shell-head, a direct application of DESIGN.md section 6.1's already-documented 'rows wrap before they crush' rule, never applied to this specific header before now

states.phone, tight width: the whole shell-status group (button + status text + cursor) drops to its own row below the title; the title itself stays single-line since it no longer competes for width on the same row

behavior: No JS involved — pure flex-wrap. If shell-status's own three children still don't fit one line at 375px, the same treatment applies one level down (verify live before considering this screen done).

components.readout text: GAP:ruled:538d1960 — font-size drops from --glance-md to --glance-sm at the phone breakpoint via a viewport-width media query; not container-query-based (Safari 15 floor), not clamp()/vw-based. Corrected at /gw-plan-review: this is the first viewport-width typography swap in this codebase, not a copy of SIATKA's own --glance-sm override (that one is an unconditional shadow-DOM cascade for nested cells, unrelated to breakpoints)

states.finished: same sizing rule, color still var(--warn) via the existing .readout.finished class
states.idle (preset picker): already correct — flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto on .presets, unaffected by this screen

behavior: No scroll affordance for the readout — a single centered number has nothing meaningful to scroll to. Shrinking is the only correct response to a squeezed cell.

components.art block: GAP:ruled:97d0c4ba — corrected at /gw-plan-review, verified via a real headless-Chrome test: flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0 on .art alone is a no-op, since Card.svelte's .card-body is not itself display:flex. Fix: wrap the card-body content in a new <div class="wrap"> (display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100%; min-height:0), matching K7ShoppingList's .wrap / Timer's .idle-wrap exactly — .art's own flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0 then does something, and its existing overflow:auto activates

states.content taller than its cell (many cards: internal scroll, same as Timer's idle preset list — no page-level scroll

behavior: Purely mechanical CSS fix — no new visual design, no new token.
